cases.title: Ask Clara starts the AI RFP flow when line items exist
steps: Wait for the request to finish.
cases.expected: The app sends POST /ask_ai_chats/rfp_questions and then GET /external_requests/:uuid. The AI RFP result or status is shown after the request completes.
cases.setup: Open a project with at least one saved line item.
gaps: The specific AI RFP result or status content shown after completion is not identified by the case and cannot be asserted with a known catalog value.

plan.title: Ask Clara AI RFP request flow

steps.note: Open the project creation screen where Ask Clara is available.
Provide the required project title for a valid create flow.
Apply a pricing template before adding line items.
Ensure line items exist, which is the precondition for the AI RFP flow.
Start the AI RFP flow.
Verify Ask Clara sent the AI RFP questions request.
Verify the app polled or fetched the external request status using the returned request identifier.
Confirm the completed flow did not leave an application error visible.

cases.title: Save as draft auto-generates an untouched project title
steps: Wait for the save to complete.
cases.expected: The draft saves successfully. "Enter the title of the project" shows an auto-generated project title instead of remaining empty.
cases.setup: Open a new project with valid line items and leave "Enter the title of the project" empty.
gaps: Saving the draft from a completely untouched create screen before selecting a template and adding a line item.

steps.note: Open the multi-stage create screen while leaving the title empty.
Provide the minimum required configuration needed to enable draft saving without entering a title.
Add the minimum line item required for Save as draft to become available.
Save the draft and wait for the save operation to complete.
Confirm the draft save completed without an application error.

args.label: Enter the title of the project

steps.note: Check that the title field no longer remains empty; the catalog can observe the field but cannot assert the exact generated title format.

cases.title: Whitespace-only project title is accepted past client validation
steps: Click "Enter the title of the project".
cases.expected: The app does not show "Please fill project title!". The publish flow proceeds to its next validation or request, and the request contains the whitespace title.
cases.setup: Open a project with valid line items and participants.
gaps: Inspecting the publish request itself and asserting that its body contains the whitespace title because the catalog requires a request path, and no publish endpoint path is provided.

steps.note: Open the multi-stage create screen for a valid publish setup.
Enter a whitespace-only project title, the value under test.
Configure the default auction stage with a pricing template.
Add the required line item.
Complete the pricing sheet so publish is not blocked by incomplete data.
Commit a valid event schedule.
Add the required participant.
Attempt publication and allow the product to proceed to its next validation or request.
Verify the whitespace-only title does not trigger the specific missing-title client validation message.
